package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/openapi"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/output"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/parameters"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/serializers"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
)

type query struct{ Page int64 }
type result struct{ Page int64 }

func prepare(authentication api.Authentication) ([]openapi.Operation, []openapi.NamedSchema, error) {
	in, err := parameters.New(128, parameters.Field("page", parameters.Default(parameters.CanonicalInt64(1, 20), int64(1)), func(value *query, page int64) { value.Page = page }, "Page."))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	out, err := output.New(output.Named("Result", output.Object(output.Field("page", output.Int64(), func(value result) int64 { return value.Page }))), serializers.Limits{})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	prepared, err := endpoint.New(authentication, endpoint.Config[query, result]{
		Route:     web.Route{Name: "consumer:list", Method: "GET", Path: "/api/items/"},
		Admission: endpoint.Authenticated(), Input: endpoint.Query(in), Output: out,
		Success: []endpoint.Status{{Code: 200, Description: "Page."}},
		Handle: func(request *web.Request, actor auth.Principal, value query) (output.Prepared[result], error) {
			return out.Prepare(request.Context(), 200, result{Page: value.Page})
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return endpoint.Collect([]endpoint.Endpoint{prepared})
}
